function ready() { return false; }
function valid() { return true; }
const flag = Boolean(1);
if (ready &&
    valid &&
    flag) console.log(1);
const label = ready && "ready";
if (flag || ready) console.log(2);
const branch = flag && valid ? "yes" : "no";
const parenthesized = (ready) && ready();
function narrowed(fn?: () => boolean) { return fn && fn && 1; }
function united(fn: (() => boolean) | (() => number)) { return fn && 1; }
